missing: Port-to-tube adapter, full installed solder envelope and independently checked local pad coordinates.

name: USound Adap UT-P2019
body_basis: Exact manufacturer nominal package dimensions. Display uses a simplified body with interface markers; tolerance, solder and carrier thickness need separate allowance.
outlet_basis: Three front cover slots. 1.40 mm is the central slot width, not the diameter of a circular sound port; the existing tube inlet is a planning transition.
wiring: Use the positive BE and negative TE contacts. Adap needs biased piezo drive (datasheet reference: 15 V DC with AC drive); a passive cable/crossover is insufficient.
mount: Support only the supplier-defined front/back contact zones. Keep the 0.80 mm back port open and avoid bending the package.
missing: Host carrier, front/rear seal, individual solder joints, amplifier placement and electrical netlist.
note: Harness approaches the documented rear contact face. Its central group anchor is a space reservation, not a measured pad centre. Display marks only the dimensioned central front slot and back vent; the two outer slots and membrane are not modeled.

name: xMEMS Cowell
body_basis: Exact manufacturer nominal package dimensions. Display uses a simplified body with interface markers; tolerance, solder and carrier thickness need separate allowance.
outlet_basis: 15 × 0.48 mm top holes; 1.859 mm equivalent-area diameter is a routing approximation, not one round physical port.
wiring: T is pin 2; B is pin 1; SM3/SM4 are mechanical. Connect T to the positive and B to the negative output of the compatible xMEMS piezo amplifier. SM lands have no electrical connection. A passive BA crossover cannot supply the required drive/bias.
mount: SMT carrier and solder enclosure ring, with a host-PCB opening exposing all two rear vents. The carrier and seal are not generated by auto arrange.
missing: Host carrier, front/rear seal, individual solder joints, amplifier placement and electrical netlist.
note: Harness approaches the documented rear contact face. Its central group anchor is a space reservation, not a measured pad centre. Dark display markers indicate front openings and rear vents, not drilled CAD bores.
